declarations.docstring: A natural-number invariant associated with a composition series of submodules and a module.
Expresses the module-factor count after removing the final member of a nonempty composition series.
Identifies the module-factor count of a composition series with the finite rank of a linear-map module under the given hypotheses.
Decomposes the finite rank of maps into a module as the sum of the ranks for a submodule and its quotient.
Shows that the finite rank of the linear-map module is zero when the bottom and top submodules agree.
Identifies maps into the top submodule with maps into the ambient module at the level of finite rank.
